$description: Component tokens — ONLY where a primitive genuinely needs one (spec 129 §5.2). The default is semantic consumption; this file stays deliberately near-empty. The control height family is the shared control-height scale the button/input/select presets are built on — compact default density (Shahzeb, 2026-10-24; spec 129 OD-4 as amended): height 36px default, heightLg 40px, heightSm 32px. Consumed through the --height-control* / --size-control* mappings in globals.css @theme.
